title: Nothing Scheduled
description: A brand-new SwiftCargo deployment with no assignments made yet should show an empty, well-formed board, not an error.
successCondition: GET /api/fleet/conflicts as a dispatcher, called when there are no overlapping assignments among the currently scheduled ones (or none scheduled at all), returns 200 with conflicts equal to an empty array [].
hints: If your environment already has seeded assignments, this test still passes as long as none of the currently-existing assignments overlap in vehicle/driver + time window — you don't strictly need a totally empty environment.
Empty is a valid, successful state here — 200 with an empty array, not a 404 or an error.
